mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering fragments into a rubble world was the most worthwhile moment: it brought the collision and rebuilding sequence together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second shattering felt somewhat repetitive after the fragile clumps broke, although it worked at a larger scale.

surprise.text: The broken grains formed compact pebbles rather than simply restoring the original clumps.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though every gameplay decision offered only one combination, so there was little meaningful choice.

continue.text: Yes; the rubble world's path toward a growing larger body makes me curious what happens next.
